title: Unit linear form with prescribed correlation
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and let $g:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. If its Fourier weight at level one, $W_1[g]=\sum_{|S|=1}\widehat g(S)^2$, is positive, then there are real coefficients $a_1,\ldots,a_n$ such that $\sum_{i=1}^n a_i^2=1$ and $\mathbb E_x[g(x)\sum_{i=1}^n a_i(-1)^{x_i}]=\sqrt{W_1[g]}$, where $x$ is uniform on the Boolean cube.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
replaced:
Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and let $g:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a real-valued cube function; write $\mathbb E[h]=2^{-n}\sum_{x\in\{0,1\}^n}h(x)$, $\widehat g(\{i\})=\mathbb E[g(x)(-1)^{x_i}]$, and $W^1[g]=\sum_{i<n}\widehat g(\{i\})^2$ for its degree-one Fourier weight.
If $W^1[g]>0$, there exist real coefficients $(a_i)_{i<n}$ such that
\[
\sum_{i<n}a_i^2=1
\quad\text{and}\quad
\mathbb E\!\left[g(x)\sum_{i<n}a_i(-1)^{x_i}\right]=\sqrt{W^1[g]}.
\]
